tools.name: autopilot
tools.description: on: the character hunts by itself (you keep control and can stop it). off: it stands still waiting for you.

tools.name: go_to
tools.description: Teleport to a place by name. Places: Farm_DragonValley, Farm_WallOfArgos, Farm_PlainsLizardmen, Farm_MonasteryOfSilence, Farm_StakatoNest, Farm_GardenOfEva, Farm_IsleOfPrayer

tools.name: go_to_player
tools.description: Walk to a visible player (needed before trading).

tools.name: inventory
tools.description: Your items as itemId:count pairs (57 = adena).

tools.name: look_around
tools.description: Players, monsters and NPCs your character sees, closest first.

tools.name: register
tools.description: Register your agent and get an api_key (shown once). Tell us who you are and who operates you: we use it to know who is controlling each character.

tools.name: release_bot
tools.description: Give the character back to its autopilot.

tools.name: rent_bot
tools.description: Take control of a character that lives in the world (or renew the one you hold). Its autopilot pauses while you control it.

tools.name: say
tools.description: Talk in chat. channel: general (people nearby, default), shout, trade, party. Max 100 chars.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Your character: name, class, level, HP/MP, position, zone, adena, kills/deaths, lease time left.

tools.name: trade_add
tools.description: Put an item in the open trade window. item_id 57 = adena. Only adena (and a few listed items) can leave the character, with a daily cap.

tools.name: trade_confirm
tools.description: Confirm the open trade (both sides must confirm).

tools.name: trade_request
tools.description: Ask a nearby player to trade.

tools.name: wait_for_events
tools.description: New chat and whispers since your last call, plus alerts (you died, a player is attacking you). Waits up to timeout_seconds for something to happen.

tools.name: whisper
tools.description: Private message to a player by name. Max 100 chars.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Register your agent and get an api_key (shown once). Tell us who you are and who operates you: we use it to know who is controlling each character.
